intent: Select the peaks that overlap at least one promoter from promoters.bed, keeping their original coordinates and scores; this peak set will be counted and carried forward to motif analysis.
silent_error: With -wa, bedtools intersect writes the original A record once for every B record it overlaps. Peaks sitting between bidirectional or overlapping promoters (peak_01, peak_04) are therefore written twice, so the 'promoter peak set' has 6 records for 4 distinct peaks. The records are byte-identical valid BED lines, nothing is printed on stderr, and a plain line count, a motif-enrichment input or a peak-count statistic silently double counts the peaks that lie between two promoters. The option that reports each A feature once is -u: '-u Write the original A entry _once_ if _any_ overlaps found in B', whereas '-wa Write the original entry in A for each overlap'.
